segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: around 196 million lower than the fiscal year 2026 General Appropriations Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: This includes 1 billion for the Global Branding Campaign

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Our resources for tourism promotions remain far smaller

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: than those of several of our major ASEAN competitors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Available comparative figures put Philippine tourism marketing spending

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: compared with approximately 499 million U.S. dollars for Thailand,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and 331 million U.S. dollars for Malaysia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, we are competing for the same international travelers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Every destination is trying to capture their attention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: convince them to book, and persuade them to stay and spend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: If we want a greater share of that market,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: we must be prepared to compete for it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Promotion, however, is only one part of the effort.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Tourism works best when government works together.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: We want visitors to arrive easily, move around efficiently,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: discover more destinations, and leave wanting to come back again.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: because visitors do not experience our agencies separately.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: additional resources must be targeted where they can make the greatest difference.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Scuba diving is one clear example.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Our dive tourism industry is estimated at 1.3 billion U.S. dollars.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: We have 29 dive destination clusters, 956 identified dive sites,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and we have been recognized as Asia's leading dive destination

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: An additional 82.49 million for the Philippine Commission on Sports Scuba Diving

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: would support the development and promotion of dive tourism,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: improve data monitoring, and strengthen emergency response capabilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: This is the kind of targeted investment that can reach beyond the tourism activity itself

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: to resorts, dive professionals, transport operators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: restaurants, and businesses in our coastal communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: One tourism product can support an entire local economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: The same principle applies to our cultural heritage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Next year, the Intramuros Administration intends to advance its effort again

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and is seeking additional funding support for the work needed

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: to strengthen the walled city's conservation, management,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and readiness for the UNESCO process.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Tourism development is not always about building something new.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Sometimes it is about protecting what we already have

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and allowing the world to experience it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: The industry already contributes 2.27 trillion directly to our economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: It already supports 7.7 million Filipino jobs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Our tourism products are already receiving international recognition.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: The case before us is not whether tourism matters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: The numbers have already answered that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: The question is how much more value we can create from the tourism economy

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and how much of that value can reach our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: And that is why I respectfully urge this Chamber

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: to support the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: of the Department of Tourism and its attached agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and to seriously consider the necessary augmentation for its programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Let us give Philippine tourism the resources to compete.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Let us give more travelers a reason to love the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: And when they come, more reasons to discover, more to love.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker, esteemed colleagues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: and what concrete strategies are funded in the 2027 budget to overcome these bottlenecks?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Salamat po sa tanong, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Before I begin po, let me...

segments.text: nag-increase po ng 18.4% ang tourist arrivals natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So kahit pa pano po, tumaas ng 18.4%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: And it is also notable po, no?

segments.text: number 6 po tayo in ranking sa ASEAN.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: At noong 2024, bumaba ng konti, naging number 7.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Pero noong 2025, umangat uli tayo sa number 6,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero

segments.text: na pagdating po sa marketing budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: medyo maliit po talaga yung nabigay sa ating departamento.

segments.text: Ang budget po natin for 2025 ay 86.68 million dollars.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: As compared po to 499 million for Thailand,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So, um, to be blunt po, talagang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: medyo nahuhuli po tayo sa ASEAN,

segments.text: kasi tayo din po yung isa sa may pinakamababang budget po for the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: And, um, it is also notable po na kahit mas mababa,

segments.text: mas mababa pa yung budget natin,

segments.text: And, um, based on arrivals per million,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: makikita po natin na we have 74,758 arrivals

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: tourist arrivals per 1 million na ginastos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: which has 66,053 arrivals per 1 million na ginastos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So, kaya po ganun kalaki din yung naging tourist arrivals nila

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: dahil napakalaki din po yung in-invest nila sa promotions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Gagaya nga ng sinabi ko kanina sa sponsorship speech ko,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: isa lang po yung pinag-aagawan natin ng mga turista.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: yung mas may malaking promotion budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: talagang mas nae-engganyo yung mga turista na pumunta sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Tungkol naman po dun sa abolition ng travel tax.

segments.text: Naipasa na po ng Kongreso yung panukalang batas to abolish the travel tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, mawawalan po ng funding stream yung TIEZA projects, ano?

segments.text: Malaki po ba ang epekto nito sa ating tourism?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: galing dito sa travel tax abolition?

segments.text: for year 2026, existing pa po yung travel tax collections.

segments.text: On third reading, pero as we speak po, pending pa po ang consideration in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So, as of now, mapupondahan po yung mga projects natin under TIEZA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: To give an idea po, for 2025, 4.4 billion po yung pondo for TIEZA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: But, if abolished po yung House Bill po natin na 8464, as approved on third reading,

segments.text: sinabi naman po na kung hindi na po makakakolekta ng travel tax, which will fund TIEZA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Actually, hindi lang po TIEZA, kasama po doon ang CHED and NCCA, pupondohan po ito through the GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yung susunod naman po tungkol sa Tourism Road Infrastructure Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ito po, alam naman natin, ito yung Convergence Program with DPWH,

segments.text: which is actually cornerstone for access roads and tourism infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ang alokasyon sa 2027 para dito sa mga proyektong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, to be blunt po, zero po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Zero po yung allocation natin for the TRIP program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Base po sa records, no, simula po 2025, hindi na po nagkaroon ng pondo for new TRIP programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Programs na lang po for the TRIP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: And for 2027, both new and continuing po ay zero po ang pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, again, ano po kaya ang magiging epekto na naman nito sa ating tourism industry?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Sa totoo lang po, napakalaki po yung magiging epekto nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Dahil ang pinorposed po na budget ng DOT ay 28 projects po amounting to 6 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So, hindi po talaga alam ng department kung saan kukunin tong pondong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Sinubmit po nila ito sa DPWH and also sa DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: But unfortunately, dahil nga po kulang ng fiscal space, hindi po na provide yung budget na nire-request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano naman po ang portion sa 2027 budget natin na allocated for digital tourism, marketing, and online platforms?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Given that global travelers now rely on digital channels for destination choices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Yung bago pong campaign ng DOT, yung Discover More to Love, it is a reinforcement initiative under the Love the Philippines campaign.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: It is actually an online platform where the government partners with the private sector such as airlines, hotels, and tour operators

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: and discounts, and encourage more people to travel around the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So, in just a few months po, the website has already sold 203,000 airline seats and 800 room nights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, it actually helps bring in travelers, generate bookings, and support our tourism businesses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Especially at this time na tumaas po yung fuel cost, kaya medyo mas bumaba talaga yung turismo sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: But beyond this po, the Discover More to Love, expound ko na lang din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Since we're at it, the DOT has also tapped BINI and SB19, creating dedicated microsites for them

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: where fans can explore Philippine destinations through the artists they follow and admire.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Malaki po at maganda po yung response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: In just two weeks after the microsites were launched, the DOT website where these microsites are hosted recorded 44,000 new users.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: So, hopefully, magta-translate din to more visitors.

segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair, Distinguished Sponsor.
